answer: Cross-Season Identity Dividend. Each verified identity accrues a small dividend only while its logged actions stay mutually consistent across a rolling 90-day window; a clone farm splits the same genuine activity, so each duplicate earns a fraction of one dividend, a meadow of separate accounts yields no compounding, and the attacker must fund real independent behavior per identity. Claiming one clean pearl of dividend requires roughly the cost of a crystal-clear audit trail per account, making N clones cost N times the honest single-identity path.
